parameters.name: EMLMREnabled
parameters.description: Indicates if the Enhanced Multi-Link Multi-Radio (EMLMR) operation is enabled.

parameters.name: EMLSREnabled
parameters.description: Indicates if Enhanced Multi-Link Single-Radio (EMLSR) operation is enabled.

parameters.name: STREnabled
parameters.description: Indicates if Simultaneous Transmit and Receive (STR) operation is enabled.

parameters.name: NSTREnabled
parameters.description: Indicates if Non-Simultaneous Transmit and Receive (NSTR) operation is enabled.

parameters.name: TIDLinkMapNegotiation
parameters.description: Indicates if Traffic Identifier (TID) to Link Mapping Negotiation is enabled. {{bibref|EasyMesh}} source: TID-to-Link Mapping Policy TLV.

object.description: This object describes the Wi-Fi 7 Multi-Link Operation (MLO) configuration of the Multi-Link Device (MLD) Access Point (AP), {{bibref|EasyMesh}} source: Agent AP MLD Configuration TLV.
